 "rationale": "Gain ≥72 dB and 1.56 V swing need a second stage with a CS output. The budget is 37 uA total: 10 uA reference, 10 uA tail and 14 uA output. GBW = gm1/Cc with a small Cc. The output stage cannot afford gm7 well above the 2*pi*GBW*CL that PM normally needs. So Rz is chosen so its LHP zero cancels p2, leaving p3 = 1/(Rz*C1) around 100 MHz. A weak-inversion, long-L input pair gives gm and flicker area."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),     # input pair gm/Id (weak inversion for efficiency)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (flicker noise area, gain)
    "itail": (10e-6, 7e-6, 13e-6),   # first-stage tail current
    "i7":    (14e-6, 10e-6, 16e-6),  # output-stage current
    "gmid7": (13.0, 9.0, 15.0),      # output PMOS gm/Id
    "L7":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),        # output PMOS L (gain vs p3)
    "L3":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),        # PMOS mirror-load L
    "ccf":   (1.15, 0.9, 1.6),       # Cc = gm1/(2*pi*28MHz) * ccf
    "rzf":   (1.0, 0.7, 1.5),        # Rz scale vs. exact p2-cancellation value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    itail, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    gmidb, Lb = 12.0, 2.0                      # NMOS bias mirror family

    # bias / current sinks (same L and gm/Id -> accurate ratios)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, itail, vds=0.3)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidb, Lb, i7, vds=0.9)

    # input pair and mirror load
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], itail / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, p["L3"], itail / 2, vds=0.9)
    # output PMOS common source
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid7"], p["L7"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    ugbw_t = 28e6
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * ugbw_t) * p["ccf"]
    c1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + 5e-15       # first-stage output node
    c2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    # LHP zero on top of p2: z = 1/(Cc(Rz - 1/gm7)) = p2 ~ gm7/c2
    rz = (1.0 + c2 / cc) / gm7 * p["rzf"]

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)     # diode side
    n.dev("M2", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)    # output side (non-inverting overall)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nc", rz)
    n.C("CC", "nc", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * rz * c1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    resid = gm7 / (2 * PI * c2) * 6.0          # imperfect cancellation, residual effect
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * pmir)))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / resid)))
    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i7)
    slew = min(itail / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    settle = 0.6 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    gm3 = m3.gm
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16 * 1.38e-23 * 300 / (3 * gm1) * (1 + gm3 / gm1))
    noise_1k = vn_th * 6.0                     # flicker-dominated estimate
    cmrr_db = db(2 * gm1 * a1 / max(m5.gds, 1e-12) / max(a1, 1e-9) * 0.5) if m5.gds > 0 else 90
    psrr_db = gain_db - 3

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "swing": swing,
               "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db}
